issues.description: Port VALUE captures any non-whitespace except ;&|, so a closing paren or quote glued to the number invalidates a real explicit port: '(vite --port 3000)' and 'vite --port "4000"' fall back to the framework default. Consider also excluding ')' and quotes from VALUE or trimming them.
'ng' command token matches without requiring 'serve' (e.g. 'ng build', 'echo ng' report @angular/cli 4200); spec A3 says '@angular/cli (ng serve)'.
Framework command match follows FRAMEWORKS table order, not script position ('vite build && next dev' reports vite). Spec is silent; acceptable.

scripts that is not an object yields reason 'no-script' (A8 lists it separately but the Detection reason set has no distinct value); matches the task contract. A shell comment 'node a.js # PORT=9' yields explicit 9. Both are acceptable edge behaviour.
No production caller sets packageJsonUnreadable yet; the wiring in the init command (T5) must pass it for ENOENT vs other read errors, otherwise A8 unreadable is still reported as missing end to end.
